title: Illinois Family Neonatal Intensive Care Leave Act
facts: Illinois Family Neonatal Intensive Care Leave took effect June 1, 2026.
For employers with 15-49 employees, eligible employees may receive up to 10 days of unpaid, job-protected leave while a child is a NICU patient, limited by the child's time in the NICU.
Different leave amounts/rules can apply by employer size; current Illinois Department of Labor guidance should be checked for the employee's situation.
